<title level="1" right="Spell 9" pfs="Standard">
[Seize Soul](/Spells.aspx?ID=1664)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Unholy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=521" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 355

**Traditions**
[Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

 

**Requirements** item worth at least the target's level × 100 gp
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 creature that died within the last minute
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** unlimited
</row>

</column>

---

You trap the target's soul in the item before the soul can pass on to the afterlife. The item used to contain the soul can be anything as long as it's of the appropriate value. The item has AC 16 and its normal Hardness and HP. Destroying (not just breaking) an item or [counteracting](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) _seize soul_ releases the soul to the afterlife. While the soul is in the item, the target can't be returned to life through any means, even powerful magic such as a _wish_ ritual. If the item is destroyed or seize soul is counteracted on the item, the soul is freed. An item can't hold more than one soul, and any attempt wastes the spell.

 You can also target an item that has had a soul trapped it in with a second casting of _seize soul_, which destroys the item and either releases the soul or relocates it to a different item, whichever you choose. This fails if the target is an [artifact](/Traits.aspx?ID=253) or the trapped soul is a creature of 19th level or higher.
